title: Stone slowly dissolves into empty space
description: Beneath the solid ground lies a hidden world carved by nothing but water. Watch how nature sculpts these hollow giants over millions of years.
instagram_caption: Nature's architecture is carved in silence. Follow for more earth science stories.

segments.narration: This solid mountain looks eternal, but water quietly eats away the deep stone.
broll_queries: water flowing over rocks close up

segments.narration: Rain absorbs carbon from the air, turning into a weak, acidic carving tool.
broll_queries: raindrops falling on leaves close up

segments.narration: The acid seeps into tiny cracks, searching for a path through the limestone.
broll_queries: water seeping into rock close up

segments.narration: Every single drop slowly dissolves the mineral, widening the gap with great patience.
broll_queries: water dripping inside cave close up

segments.narration: Hidden rivers gather these mineral pieces, carrying the stone away into the dark.
Over thousands of years, the narrow cracks grow into massive, silent underground chambers.
Rich minerals drip from above, building delicate stone icicles that defy the gravity.
broll_queries: stalactites hanging in cave close up

segments.narration: Lightless rooms bloom with jagged sculptures, born from the slow work of time.
A hollow universe is revealed where once there was only thick, heavy earth.
